Tarikh | Episode 1032 | 31 July 2025
The 1925 Lakhochak incident in Munger, Bihar, marked an early stage of caste-based violence, stemming from the Janeu Andolan.
The Janeu Andolan, starting in the early 20th century, symbolized lower castes' assertion of their identity, aiming for social upliftment and political mobilization.
Influenced by the Arya Samaj and leaders like Ras Bihari Mandal, the movement challenged traditional caste hierarchies and led to events like the Lakhochak clash.
